Application Data.NAME: FreshMart Supermarket
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: FreshMart Supermarket operates as a full-service grocery store, providing a wide variety of fresh produce, meats, dairy products, canned goods, and household essentials. Our facility spans over 5,000 square feet, ensuring ample space for inventory and customer shopping. We prioritize food safety and compliance, adhering strictly to local health regulations, including regular safety audits and employee training programs in line with FDA Food Code and HACCP protocols. Our operations do not include any on-site fuel sales, minimizing environmental risks. We also have a robust risk management strategy in place, including surveillance systems to prevent theft and employee dishonesty, along with a documented emergency response plan for equipment failures. FreshMart is committed to delivering quality products while maintaining a safe and secure shopping environment for our customers.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 04/15/2023, FreshMart Supermarket experienced a refrigeration compressor failure resulting in food spoilage valued at $5,000. The incident was promptly reported, and corrective measures were implemented, including the replacement of the compressor and an upgrade of the temperature monitoring system. The claim is currently in a closed status, with no further pending actions.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system with 24/7 monitoring, perimeter fencing, and regular security patrols.
